info.title: Muninn API
info.description: REST API for automating Muninn, a self-hosted dashboard for your homelab and server fleet. The REST surface covers boards, apps, users, invites, server settings, API keys, integrations and groups. The broader automation surface (Docker, Kubernetes, logs, widgets and more) is available through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint at /api/mcp.
